svg.title: Copy-neutral loss of heterozygosity after crossover
svg.desc: Starting diploid A/a cell before replication, then A/A and a/a daughter cells after replication, one crossover between the centromere and marker, and the LOH-producing segregation. The four-chromatid intermediate is omitted. Each daughter retains two centromeres; proximal origin colors differ while distal marker alleles match. Other segregation outcomes can retain heterozygosity.
